decisions.git_trees_and_symlinks: Read pinned Git objects only; preserve mode 120000 and never follow symlink targets.

unknown_policy.file_side: Any truth-Unknown occurrence, unread eligible path or missing resolver context makes the complete file-side unscorable for both tools.
unknown_policy.case_side: Any unknown file-side makes the containing case-side unscorable for deduplicated edge metrics.
unknown_policy.case_change: Both relevant sides must be complete; otherwise the change and corresponding rule comparison are Unknown.
unknown_policy.tool_failure: A crash, malformed output or unsupported response remains a failed attempted run and cannot remove a truth-eligible case from paired accounting.
unknown_policy.adjudication: Any disagreement not resolved from frozen source evidence remains Unknown; original reviews are never overwritten.
